text: dsh-werewolf 是面向 DSH Web 的 AI 狼人杀游戏插件，在 Web 界面的浮层挂件中提供对局面板。玩家可以选择 6、9 或 12 人局，启动 AI 观战或亲自加入一席；对局由 DSH 当前选中的模型驱动，并呈现玩家座位、发言记录、游戏日志和阶段状态。游戏包含狼人、预言家、女巫、平民、守卫和猎人等身份，以及夜间行动、白天发言与投票流程。适合想在 DSH Web 中体验 AI 社交推理游戏的用户；无需单独配置模型密钥，插件调用 DSH 已选模型。

dsh-werewolf adds an AI Werewolf panel to DSH Web. Choose 6, 9, or 12 seats to spectate or join a game. It uses DSH’s selected model and shows players, speeches, logs, and voting. No separate model key is configured.
想在 DSH Web 里开一局 AI 狼人杀，可以观战也可以自己加入。
有没有能让我和 AI 一起玩狼人杀的 DSH 插件？
I want to play or spectate an AI Werewolf game inside DSH Web.
dsh-werewolf 的功能「AI 观战或真人参赛」：在面板中选择 6、9 或 12 人局后，可启动全 AI 对局，或让用户加入一个座位；服务端通过 DSH 当前模型生成 AI 玩家行动。
dsh-werewolf 的功能「狼人杀对局面板」：通过 DSH Web 浮层打开挂件，查看座位、发言和游戏日志，并在需要时提交真人玩家的操作。
dsh-werewolf 的维护与更新元数据：低活跃；距最后推送 85 天；提交数 1；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 47/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-werewolf README · dsh-werewolf：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

An AI-powered Werewolf game for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. Watch a complete AI game or join one seat as a human player.

dsh-werewolf README · Features：- 6, 9, and 12-seat games.
- AI-only spectator mode and single-human participation mode.
- Werewolf, Seer, Witch, Villager, Guard, and Hunter roles.
- Sheriff election, badge transfer, speeches, voting, tie-break rounds, and night actions.
- Uses the model currently selected in DeepSeek Harness.

dsh-werewolf README · Install：After the first npm release, install the prebuilt package into the Web profile, then restart DSH Web:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-werewolf --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
dsh web
```

For local development:

```sh
pnpm install --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
pnpm run check
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

dsh-werewolf README · Development：```sh
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run test
pnpm run build
npm pack --dry-run

The Host entry is maintained in `src/index.js` and copied to `lib/index.js` during the build. TypeScript domain modules compile into `lib/`, and `src/client/index.js` is bundled into the browser entry at `client/client.js`.

dsh-werewolf README · Runtime scope：The game is process-local and currently supports one active game per DSH Web process. Its RPC channel is loopback-only. Restarting the DSH process discards the active game.
